This app only provides launching, configuration, and management of game runtime environments. It does not include, host, or distribute any game data, commercial assets, or cracked resources.

The emulators and compatibility runtimes used by this app (including third-party components) are independent projects, and their copyrights belong to their respective authors. Before use, make sure you legally own and are entitled to run the games concerned, and comply with the licenses of both the games and the emulators.

Any save corruption, data loss, device malfunction, account suspension, or other direct or indirect damages arising from running games with this app are borne solely by the user. The developers make no guarantee regarding game compatibility, stability, or results.

Do not use this app for copyright infringement, piracy, or any purpose that violates applicable laws and regulations.
